hedging_delta.evidence: More definitive statements ('things are now much more stable', 'we did bottom in Q2') vs prior quarter's more tentative recovery language.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided FY24 revenue to $51B and AI revenue over $11B; current raises FY24 to $51.5B and AI to $12B.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: VMware EBITDA target of $8.5B in 3 years now expected to be met or exceeded in FY25, vs no such timing claim before.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New VCF/VMware Explore conference and CPU core booking metric (15M cores, 80% of bookings) not discussed in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Confident claims like 'strength continues', 'well on the path to achieving or even exceeding' vs prior's more cautious 'modest recovery' framing.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Non-AI networking up 17% sequentially and 'bottomed' confirmed, server storage up 5% sequentially, vs prior call's forecasted 'modest recovery' not yet realized.
